A SUPERVISOR FOR AGENT-BUILT SOFTWARE
Build. Review. Prove. Commit.

Codex builds each phase. Claude reviews the work with a critical eye. Acceptance checks run in a sandbox with no network access. Nothing reaches your repo until it's been reviewed.

  • Stops when you told it to stop
  • Only commits reviewed work
